name: Ura Saiminjutsu 2
source:
This is the first fandisc of Saiminjutsu 2, featuring an original story with new protagonists (the Kirishima twin sisters), 4 situation stories with the original characters of Saiminjutsu 2 and a bonus scenario with a girl from Soukan Yuugi.

[Edited from ErogeShop.com]
